tasks.title: Regenerate and commit a reproducible lockfile
tasks.description: npm ci currently fails because package-lock.json is out of sync with package.json (missing Vitest transitive packages and version mismatches). Regenerate the lockfile with the supported package manager, commit it, and verify npm ci && npm run build && npm test pass from a clean checkout.
evidence: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund fails with missing lock entries and invalid @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec resolution
npm install followed by npm run build and npm test passes
acceptance: Clean checkout installs with npm ci without modifying the lockfile

tasks.title: Add deterministic signal and market-discovery tests
tasks.description: The product's core value is the live SMA/market comparison, but the repo only contains the starter example test. Add unit tests around computeSmaSignal and market slug/discovery parsing, including empty buffers, timeframe window boundaries, neutral threshold, malformed API payloads, and expired-market rotation.
evidence: src/lib/smaSignal.ts and src/lib/polymarket.ts are core active modules
Only one starter test file was found
acceptance: At least 10 focused tests cover signal edge cases and discovery parsing
A malformed or empty API response produces a safe UI state rather than a thrown render error

tasks.title: Make Telegram ingest failure-safe and observable
tasks.description: Harden supabase/functions/telegram-webhook so Firecrawl, Telegram, AI classification, and database failures return bounded responses, do not create partial thread records, and emit structured correlation-safe logs/metrics. Add tests for URL scrape failure, invalid link code, duplicate update delivery, and unsupported message shapes.
evidence: telegram-webhook is a production edge-function path described in README
The repo has only the starter example test and no function-level tests
acceptance: Duplicate Telegram update IDs are idempotent
Firecrawl/AI failure does not leave an orphan thread
Webhook returns Telegram-safe status in every tested failure mode
Tests cover the four named cases

tasks.title: Split the oversized frontend bundle by route
tasks.description: The production build succeeds but emits a 779.67 kB minified JS chunk. Add route-level lazy loading for dashboard, thread library, optimizer, agent docs, and auth routes, then verify the initial chunk drops materially without breaking protected-route navigation.
evidence: Vite reports index-CHTPGsnA.js at 779.67 kB and recommends dynamic import/code splitting
acceptance: Initial entry chunk is below 500 kB or the repo documents an intentional exception
All primary routes still load in a production preview
npm run build and npm test pass
